description: AGSC-08-13 fixes the blob threshold of the injection scan at 256 characters (since rc.5): a base64 run of 255 characters in item prose is below it and raises no AGSC-E401 or AGSC-E402. Together with lint-0029 this pins the boundary itself, which no vector did before rc.6. The run uses only the base64 alphabet and stands alone between spaces, so no other clause of the scan applies.
